title: Santa clock — motor replaced and rewired
description: This animated Santa with grandfather clock needed a motor swap. We disassembled the figure, disconnected the wiring, fitted a replacement motor, rewired the drive, and reassembled him so the animation runs again.
itemDetails: This seated Santa beside a green grandfather clock matches mid-1990s Holiday Creations–style animated Christmas displays. Typical features are Santa on a stool with wire glasses, a white quill pen, red trousers with fur trim and a green vest, a tall clock with Roman-numeral face and pendulum window, a “24 DEC” style date tag, a gift sack at the base, and a red coat draped on the clock. Related Holiday Creations pieces from about 1993–1995 often combined plug-in animation (head and arm motion) with a working quartz clock and sometimes music or a cassette storyteller. Construction is a plastic chassis under textile costume on a felt-topped display base with an AC cord and control knob. Exact maker/year on this example is identified from construction and scene style rather than a confirmed readable label in the photos.
repairDetails: Santa’s animation motor had failed. We disassembled the figure to reach the drive, disconnected the wiring, removed the old motor, fitted a replacement, rewired the connections, and reassembled the costume and chassis so the motion runs cleanly again.
